entries.measures: Physical volume of each connected component.

entries.measures: Fraction of the label's voxels belonging to its single largest piece.

entries.measures: Sizes of components below the configured noise threshold.

entries.measures: Total physical volume of every non-dominant component.

groups.intro: 6-connectivity (face-neighbour only) connected-components analysis of each label's voxel mask via scipy.ndimage.label (or the CuPy equivalent on GPU); item 098 promotes the non-dominant ('stray') component population to first-class fields alongside the original item 012/025 measures.

entries.computation: centroid_voxel[i] x spacing[i] per axis -- correct under anisotropic spacing.

entries.measures: Mean (x, y, z) voxel-index position of the label's voxels.

entries.computation: Promoted from the label's LabelCentroid record.

entries.measures: Anatomical vertebra name, e.g. "T8", "L3".

groups.intro: Centre of mass of each label's voxel mask, plus the integer label/anatomical level_name identity pair every other per-label block below re-carries.

entries.computation: None when no labels are present; otherwise a nested object (see the individual relationships.* fields).
entries.measures: Case-level spine relationships, or null for a 0-label map.

entries.computation: True iff each level's canonical rank is >= the previous one, walking the labels in their input order.
entries.measures: Whether the levels were labelled in a head-to-tail-consistent order.

entries.computation: Set difference between the canonical-order slice [first_present..last_present] and the present-levels set.
entries.measures: Canonical levels absent within the observed present-level span.

entries.computation: Euclidean distance (mm) between each consecutive pair in canonical order.
entries.measures: Centroid-to-centroid distance between anatomically adjacent levels.

entries.computation: Every level, in input order, whose canonical rank is lower than the running maximum.
entries.measures: Level names that broke the monotonic canonical-rank check.

entries.computation: Every centroid whose level_name is in the canonical vocabulary, sorted by canonical rank.
entries.measures: Recognised anatomical levels, in canonical head-to-tail order.

groups.intro: Computed once per case from the full ordered set of centroids (ascending integer-label order).
groups.title: Case-Level Relationships

entries.computation: Empty when no two labels' voxel masks share a voxel; feature_report.build_features_block sorts non-empty entries by (label_a, label_b).
entries.measures: The list of overlapping label pairs for this case.

entries.computation: features.overlap.detect_overlaps enforces label_a < label_b.
entries.measures: The lower integer label of an overlapping pair.

entries.computation: features.overlap.detect_overlaps enforces label_a < label_b.
entries.measures: The higher integer label of an overlapping pair.

entries.computation: Looked up via the active LabelConvention; "unknown" for an unmapped integer.

entries.computation: Looked up via the active LabelConvention; "unknown" for an unmapped integer.
entries.measures: Anatomical vertebra name for label_b.

entries.computation: Bitwise AND of the two labels' boolean mask channels, counted with count_nonzero.
entries.measures: Number of voxels claimed by both labels of the pair.

groups.intro: Requires a boolean per-label mask stack (a single integer label map cannot represent a voxel claimed by two labels at once).
groups.title: Voxel Overlap

entries.computation: Coarse 500-point scan over u, refined with a bounded scipy.optimize.minimize_scalar (xatol 1e-6).
entries.measures: Spline parameter (0-1) of the point on the curve nearest this vertebra's centroid.

entries.computation: centroid_mm - closest spline point, x component.
entries.measures: Signed x-axis displacement from the fitted spline.

entries.computation: centroid_mm - closest spline point, y component.
entries.measures: Signed y-axis displacement from the fitted spline.

entries.computation: centroid_mm - closest spline point, z component.
entries.measures: Signed z-axis displacement from the fitted spline.

entries.computation: True for index 0 and index n-1 of the sequence (and every entry when n <= 2); false otherwise. The mislabel rule and the reference distribution both exclude a terminal entry from their offset judgement, because the held-out refit must extrapolate past the end of its own parameter domain there, which reads an implausibly large offset unrelated to real displacement.
entries.measures: Whether this entry is the first or last vertebra of the ordered centroid sequence it was measured in (item 123) -- true for a field-of-view / anatomical end, false for an interior vertebra.

entries.computation: Copied from the source VertebralSplineOffset dataclass.
entries.measures: The integer label this spline-offset entry describes.

entries.computation: Copied from the source VertebralSplineOffset dataclass.
entries.measures: Anatomical vertebra name for this spline-offset entry.

entries.computation: Euclidean distance (mm) to the closest spline point at closest_u.
entries.measures: Perpendicular distance from the vertebra's centroid to the fitted spline.

entries.computation: Same as offset_mm but with each axis scaled by 1/spacing before taking the norm.
entries.measures: Anisotropic-aware perpendicular offset.

groups.intro: A cubic (degree clamped to n_points-1 when the sequence is short) smoothing B-spline is fit through the ordered centroids' mm-coordinates (scipy.interpolate.make_splprep, s = n_points by default); this spline underlies the per-vertebra offset measured here and the orientation/curvature/consistency families below. offset_mm is a held-out (leave-one-out, down-weighted) measurement (item 120): a level's offset is its closest-approach distance to a curve refit with that level and the case's dominant outlier down-weighted to a negligible constant, so the level under test cannot pull the curve toward itself. dx_mm/dy_mm/dz_mm are anatomically readable -- array axis 0 left-right, axis 1 anterior-posterior, axis 2 cranio-caudal -- only because io.load_volume reorients every volume to axis codes (R, A, S) and centroid_mm carries no affine of its own. is_terminal (item 123) marks the first/last vertebra of the sequence; the mislabel rule and the reference distribution both treat offset_mm as an interior-only feature, excluding a terminal entry from their judgement, because the held-out refit extrapolates past the end of its parameter domain there.
groups.title: Spline Offset

entries.computation: max - min of coronal_tangent_angles_deg. 0.0 for a curve confined to the sagittal plane. Requires RAS-ordered mm centroids, guaranteed by io.load_volume.
entries.measures: Coronal-plane (R-S) curvature sweep.

entries.computation: degrees(atan2(t_R, t_S)) per centroid, unwrapped along the ordered sequence, computed from tangents normalised so the sequence advances superiorly. Requires RAS-ordered mm centroids (axis 0 = Right, 1 = Anterior, 2 = Superior), guaranteed by io.load_volume.
entries.measures: Signed tangent angle in the coronal (R-S) plane at each centroid; positive tilts toward the patient's right as the spine advances cranially.

entries.computation: "coronal" when coronal_curvature_deg >= sagittal_curvature_deg, else "sagittal". An exact tie, including a straight spine's 0.0/0.0, resolves to "coronal".
entries.measures: Which anatomical plane (coronal or sagittal) total_curvature_deg came from.

entries.computation: Angle between each pair of adjacent unit tangent vectors along the spine, read as if the tangents were normalised so the sequence advances superiorly (item 122); already invariant to traversal direction so no negation is needed to produce that reading.
entries.measures: Angle between consecutive vertebrae's tangent vectors.

entries.computation: max - min of sagittal_tangent_angles_deg. 0.0 for a curve confined to the coronal plane. Requires RAS-ordered mm centroids, guaranteed by io.load_volume.
entries.measures: Sagittal-plane (A-S) curvature sweep.

entries.computation: degrees(atan2(t_A, t_S)) per centroid, unwrapped along the ordered sequence, computed from tangents normalised so the sequence advances superiorly. Requires RAS-ordered mm centroids (axis 0 = Right, 1 = Anterior, 2 = Superior), guaranteed by io.load_volume.
entries.measures: Signed tangent angle in the sagittal (A-S) plane at each centroid; positive tilts anterior.

entries.computation: Evaluated at each vertebra's stored u via the spline's first derivative (evaluate_spline_derivative, nu=1), from tangents normalised so the sequence advances superiorly (item 131), invariant to whether the caller supplied centroids cranial-first or caudal-first.
entries.measures: Angle between the spline's local tangent and the superior-inferior axis, per vertebra.

entries.computation: max(coronal_curvature_deg, sagittal_curvature_deg); 0 for a perfectly straight column. curvature_plane names which plane it came from.
entries.measures: Global curvature magnitude: the larger of the coronal and sagittal per-plane sweeps.

entries.computation: lambda_max / lambda_second of the PCA covariance; infinite for a degenerate flat cloud, 0 for a single-voxel label.
entries.measures: Anisotropy of the per-vertebra voxel cloud.

entries.computation: Copied from the source VertebralOrientation dataclass.
entries.measures: The integer label this orientation entry describes.

entries.computation: Copied from the source VertebralOrientation dataclass.
entries.measures: Anatomical vertebra name for this orientation entry.

entries.computation: Eigenvector of the largest eigenvalue of the 3x3 covariance of the mean-centred, spacing-scaled voxel coordinates. Demoted (item 121): measured across all nine committed corpus goldens (2026-08-29), every per_label_orientations entry satisfies abs(dot(principal_axis, (1,0,0))) >= 0.996, and on seven of the nine cases it is exactly [1.0, 0.0, 0.0] on every vertebra -- the fixture body's widest side, which never discriminates between vertebrae. Prefer spline_tangent_coronal_deg / spline_tangent_sagittal_deg as the per-vertebra orientation estimate.
entries.measures: Per-vertebra orientation via PCA of its voxel cloud.

entries.computation: compute_spline_offsets(centroids, fit).closest_u for this label -- the same coarse-scan-plus-refinement estimator stage3.per_label_offsets[].closest_u uses, but against the in-sample fit rather than a held-out refit (the two are distinguished by the spline_ prefix on this key).
entries.measures: Spline parameter (0-1) of the point on the fitted curve nearest this vertebra's centroid, evaluated against the shared in-sample fit (item 121).

entries.computation: evaluate_spline_derivative(fit, [spline_closest_u], nu=1), unit-normalised and negated when the ordered centroid sequence's net advance is caudal, so the estimate is invariant to traversal direction. Anatomically readable (axis 0 = Right, 1 = Anterior, 2 = Superior) only because io.load_volume reorients every volume to axis codes (R, A, S).
entries.measures: Unit-normalised tangent of the fitted spinal curve at this vertebra's own closest point on it (item 121) -- an orientation proxy, not a vertebral coordinate system.

entries.computation: degrees(atan2(t_R, t_S)) of spline_tangent, wrapped to (-180, 180] and deliberately not unwrapped (unlike stage3.curvature.coronal_tangent_angles_deg, this is a single per-vertebra reading, not a sequence to accumulate a sweep over). Positive means the curve tilts toward the patient's right as it advances cranially. Requires RAS-ordered mm centroids (axis 0 = Right, 1 = Anterior, 2 = Superior), guaranteed by io.load_volume.
entries.measures: Signed coronal (R-S plane) tilt of the fitted spinal curve at this vertebra's own closest point on it -- an orientation proxy, not a vertebral coordinate system. Varies across levels where principal_axis is measured constant on the committed corpus.

entries.computation: degrees(atan2(t_A, t_S)) of spline_tangent, wrapped to (-180, 180] and deliberately not unwrapped, the same convention as spline_tangent_coronal_deg. Positive means the curve tilts anterior. Requires RAS-ordered mm centroids (axis 0 = Right, 1 = Anterior, 2 = Superior), guaranteed by io.load_volume.
entries.measures: Signed sagittal (A-S plane) tilt of the fitted spinal curve at this vertebra's own closest point on it -- an orientation proxy, not a vertebral coordinate system. Varies across levels where principal_axis is measured constant on the committed corpus.

groups.intro: Per-vertebra orientation (PCA of the mean-centred, spacing-scaled voxel cloud) and case-level curvature summaries derived from the same fitted spline's local tangent at each vertebra. Item 121 adds a per-vertebra tangent-based orientation proxy -- the fitted curve's tangent at each vertebra's own closest point on it, read as two wrapped signed in-plane angles -- that actually varies across levels where the PCA principal_axis is measured constant on the committed corpus; it is not a vertebral coordinate system.
groups.title: Orientation & Curvature

entries.computation: False as soon as u[i] >= u[i+1] anywhere in the ordered sequence, measured against a curve fitted through the centroids in traversal order (item 132).
entries.measures: Whether every vertebra's closest-spline-parameter u increases along the anatomical order.

entries.computation: Consecutive (level_a, level_b) pairs where u[i] >= u[i+1] on the traversal-ordered reference curve (item 132); equal u values count as a violation too.
entries.measures: Level-name pairs whose spline parameter does not advance.

entries.computation: The closest_u value computed for every vertebra against a curve fitted through the centroids in traversal order (item 132), not the order under test.
entries.measures: Each vertebra's closest-spline-parameter u, in input order.

entries.computation: population-std(spacings) / mean(spacings); 0.0 when there is only one spacing.
entries.measures: Regularity of inter-vertebra spacing.

entries.computation: spacings_mm[i] - mean_spacing_mm.
entries.measures: Per-pair spacing's signed deviation from the mean.

entries.computation: Arithmetic mean of the neighbour-to-neighbour centroid distances.
entries.measures: Mean inter-vertebra centroid spacing.

entries.computation: A pair is an outlier when its spacing is >= 2.0x or <= 0.3x the mean spacing (both thresholds configurable).
entries.measures: Level-name pairs whose spacing is an outlier.

entries.computation: Euclidean centroid-to-centroid distance for each adjacent pair, in input order.
entries.measures: Per-pair inter-vertebra centroid spacing.

groups.intro: Inter-vertebra centroid spacing regularity and whether each vertebra's closest-spline-parameter u increases along the anatomical order, both derived from the same fitted spline.
groups.title: Spacing & Monotonic Consistency

entries.computation: max() of the leave-one-out z-scores (per scored feature) of the focal vertebra against the other window members.
entries.measures: How anomalous the focal vertebra's scored features are relative to its sliding-window neighbours.

entries.computation: deviation_score >= the configured outlier_threshold (default 2.0).
entries.measures: Whether the focal vertebra is flagged as a local neighbourhood outlier.

entries.computation: Copied verbatim from the focal centroid.

entries.computation: Copied verbatim from the focal centroid.
entries.measures: Anatomical level name of the focal vertebra in this neighbourhood entry.

entries.computation: Mean of per_label_offsets[].offset_mm over the window indices.

entries.computation: Median of per_label_offsets[].offset_mm over the window indices.
entries.measures: Median spline offset (mm) over the sliding window (including the focal vertebra).

entries.computation: Population std (ddof=0) of per_label_offsets[].offset_mm over the window indices.
entries.measures: Standard deviation of spline offset (mm) over the sliding window (including the focal vertebra).

entries.computation: abs(focal offset_mm - mean of neighbour offset_mm) / max(std of neighbour offset_mm, _MIN_STD).
entries.measures: The focal vertebra's spline offset expressed as a leave-one-out z-score against its window neighbours.

entries.computation: Mean, over the window, of a caller-supplied per-element spacing value: the distance to the next vertebra in the ordered sequence (the last vertebra reuses the distance to its previous neighbour).
entries.measures: Mean per-element inter-centroid spacing (mm) over the sliding window (including the focal vertebra).

entries.computation: Median, over the window, of the same per-element spacing value used for the mean.
entries.measures: Median per-element inter-centroid spacing (mm) over the sliding window (including the focal vertebra).

entries.computation: Population std (ddof=0), over the window, of the same per-element spacing value used for the mean.
entries.measures: Standard deviation of per-element inter-centroid spacing (mm) over the sliding window (including the focal vertebra).

entries.computation: abs(focal spacing_mm - mean of neighbour spacing_mm) / max(std of neighbour spacing_mm, _MIN_STD).
entries.measures: The focal vertebra's per-element spacing expressed as a leave-one-out z-score against its window neighbours. Reported but deliberately unscored by default -- see UNSCORED_RATIONALE in segfacet.features.neighbourhood.

entries.computation: Mean of per_label.{label}.geometry.physical_volume_mm3 over the window indices.
entries.measures: Mean per-label physical volume (mm3) over the sliding window (including the focal vertebra).

entries.computation: Median of per_label.{label}.geometry.physical_volume_mm3 over the window indices.
entries.measures: Median per-label physical volume (mm3) over the sliding window (including the focal vertebra).

entries.computation: Population std (ddof=0) of per_label.{label}.geometry.physical_volume_mm3 over the window indices.
entries.measures: Standard deviation of per-label physical volume (mm3) over the sliding window (including the focal vertebra).

entries.computation: abs(focal volume_mm3 - mean of neighbour volume_mm3) / max(std of neighbour volume_mm3, _MIN_STD).
entries.measures: The focal vertebra's physical volume expressed as a leave-one-out z-score against its window neighbours.

entries.computation: Labels of the elements at window indices max(0, i - window_n//2) .. min(n-1, i + window_n//2).
entries.measures: Integer labels of every vertebra in the focal vertebra's sliding window (including itself).

entries.computation: NumPy's default linear interpolation.

entries.computation: Default 1 (segfacet.reference.delta.DEFAULT_LOWER_PCT).
entries.measures: The lower percentile bound defining the reference in-range band.

entries.computation: Literal "1.0" (item 046), independent of the reference artifact's own schema_version.
entries.measures: Schema-version discriminator for the reference_delta block.

entries.measures: The reference artifact's own schema version, echoed for provenance.

entries.computation: e.g. "all" (segfacet.reference.schema.ALL_STRATUM).

entries.measures: Whether this label's level (and stratum) is covered by the reference.

entries.computation: value < percentiles[p{lower_pct}] or value > percentiles[p{upper_pct}].
entries.measures: Whether the value falls outside the configured percentile band.

entries.computation: Piecewise-linear interpolation over the reference's stored percentile grid, anchored at min/max.
entries.measures: Where the case's value falls in the reference's percentile grid.

entries.computation: (value - p50) / (IQR / 1.349), IQR = p75 - p25 from the reference; None when the reference IQR is 0.

entries.computation: Read directly from the case's features_block for this label.

entries.computation: (value - mean) / std; None when the reference std is 0 for this feature/level.
